It consists of services attached to overseas travel insurance that are entrusted by non-life insurance companies, and services developed in-house under direct contracts with companies, universities and government agencies. Depending on the calling region and time of day, the company and six overseas centers receive calls, and the Tokyo head office provides advanced coordination, including for seriously ill patients, on a 24-hour basis.
